text:
Recommendation: Don't sign the 5-year lease on Monday. First test whether demand exists.
Why:
- One year of rent ($72k) exceeds your savings plus a year of profit ($30k + $36k = $66k)
- The $60k loan is personally guaranteed, so losses reach beyond the shop
- Selling out by 2pm shows supply runs short and locals want more, but doesn't show people across town will come
Risks and unknowns:
- The landlord may lease the site to someone else while you run a test
Next steps:
1. Before Monday, ask the landlord for a 3-week hold and a break clause; if refused, walk
2. Bake about 20% more for 2 weeks and count sales after 2pm - success: sells out 8 of 10 days; stop if: most of the extra goes unsold
3. Cost out the new site (rent, loan, staff, ingredients) - success: breaks even under $22k/month; stop if: it needs more sales than your current shop makes
